$$\frac{1+\sqrt2}{2+\sqrt3}=\frac{(1+\sqrt2)(2-\sqrt3)}{4-3}=2+2\sqrt2-\sqrt3-\sqrt6.$$

Grouping the terms gives $2(1+\sqrt2)-(\sqrt3+\sqrt6)$. So $A=2$, $B=2$, $C=3$, $D=6$, and $A+B+C+D=13$.
